author: cairn
blurb: Search Wikipedia and fetch clean article summaries. No API key needed.

definition.name: Wikipedia
definition.description: Search Wikipedia and retrieve article summaries via the MediaWiki REST + Action APIs.

operations.name: search_wikipedia
operations.description: Search Wikipedia article titles and snippets by keyword.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"search_wikipedia","description":"Search Wikipedia for articles matching a query.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"srsearch":{"type":"string","description":"Search terms"},"srlimit":{"type":"number","description":"Max results (default 10)"}},"required":["srsearch"]}}

operations.name: get_wikipedia_summary
operations.description: Get the plain-text summary (intro extract + thumbnail) for a Wikipedia article by title.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_wikipedia_summary","description":"Get the summary of a Wikipedia article by exact title.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string","description":"Exact article title, e.g. 'Alan Turing'"}},"required":["title"]}}
